drivingQuestion: What is the reasoning of Beit Hillel?

segments.he: דַּם טׇהֳרָה שֶׁל מְצוֹרַעַת, בֵּית שַׁמַּאי כּוּ׳. מַאי טַעְמָא דְּבֵית הִלֵּל? אָמַר רַבִּי יִצְחָק: ״לַזָּכָר״ — לְרַבּוֹת מְצוֹרָע לְמַעְיְנוֹתָיו, ״וְלַנְּקֵבָה״ — לְרַבּוֹת מְצוֹרַעַת לְמַעְיְנוֹתֶיהָ.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: With regard to «blood» discharged «by» a female Jewish «leper» during the days «of purity» of a woman who gives birth, «Beit Shammai» deem it ritually pure and Beit Hillel say it imparts impurity only while moist. The Gemara asks: «What is the reasoning of Beit Hillel,» i.e., from where is their opinion derived? «Rabbi Yitzḥak says:» The verse states at the conclusion of the passage discussing impure individuals: “Whether it be a male or a female” (Leviticus 15:33). «“Whether it be a male”» serves «to include the sources» of bodily emissions «of a male leper,» teaching that they also impart impurity. Likewise, the phrase «“or a female”» serves «to include the sources» of bodily emissions «of a female leper,» teaching that they too impart impurity.
